description: This file defines a helper class 'Html' for parsing HTML strings into PhpSpreadsheet RichText objects, including handling of HTML tags and styles.

classes.name: Html
classes.description: Helper class for converting HTML strings into PhpSpreadsheet RichText objects, supporting HTML tags and styles.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Resets style properties and internal stacks to initial state.

methods.name: toRichTextObject
methods.description: Converts an HTML string into a RichText object, parsing HTML tags and applying styles.

methods.name: cleanWhitespace
methods.description: Cleans up whitespace in the RichText elements, trimming leading spaces and spaces after line breaks.

methods.name: buildTextRun
methods.description: Creates a text run in the RichText object with current styles and resets string data.

methods.name: rgbToColour
methods.description: Converts an RGB string to a hexadecimal color code.

methods.name: colourNameLookup
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal color code for a given color name.

methods.name: startFontTag
methods.description: Handles the start of a <font> tag, extracting style attributes.

methods.name: breakTag
methods.description: Adds a newline to the text data.

methods.name: parseTextNode
methods.description: Processes a DOMText node, normalizing whitespace and appending to text data.

methods.name: handleCallback
methods.description: Invokes the appropriate callback method for a given HTML tag.

methods.name: parseElementNode
methods.description: Processes a DOMElement node, handling start/end tag callbacks and parsing child nodes.

methods.name: parseElements
methods.description: Recursively processes child nodes of a DOM node.
